status: predeclared after open-loop v1, before any v2 execution
change: Remove the universal 0.6 next-action confidence cutoff for this bounded read-only review experiment. Select the highest-probability available action; retain all probabilities in the trace. No edit/publication/merge authority is granted.
reason: All three open-loop states selected plausible actions with confidence below 0.6, causing v1 to route every case to a human. Choice concentration mixes uncertainty about facts with competition between acceptable next actions.
hypothesis: Allowing low-confidence read-only action preferences will execute useful verification instead of escalating all cases, while preserving known distinct findings and scope limits.
unchanged: Cases, questions, evidence, model identities, effort, fallback policy, action menu, per-arm ceilings, executor prompts, and success criteria.
comparison: Run only the changed Jev arm; reuse the same-run fixed_verify controls. This is a development iteration on exposed cases, not an independent validation cohort.
limits: No claim that confidence can be ignored for factual verdicts, edits, or high-impact actions. Finalize means report completion, never a clean bill of health.
